artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan hardening the research deliverable: axiom audit of the five probes, new sorry-free probes discharging the report's checkable UNVERIFIED labels (sep-without-Limit on the funnel, dwell-time discreteness, cone topology on the two-origin frame, the hedgehog frame separating the neighbourhood topology from the final topology), and report reconciliation; no library or manuscript edits.

memory_candidates.content: For a lean4 research task whose deliverable is a report plus probe files under specs/ (not Lake modules), the implement round is 'harden the deliverable': re-verify probes, append #print axioms lines so the axiom claim is self-checking, discharge UNVERIFIED labels that fit a bounded budget as new probes, and reconcile the report's table with declaration names. The plan-format Lean Challenge Statements section must still be written; because lean-challenge-snapshot.sh counts every theorem/lemma/def/instance and truncates anything after a matched declaration's ':=', restate supporting definitions as abbrev/inductive placed BEFORE the first theorem so the declared identifier set equals the Goals set exactly, and type-check the block with lake env lean at planning time. The Comparator route itself is inapplicable to specs/-resident probes.
